pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Teachings of Prophet Amos? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Teachings of Prophet Amos.
   B. Say Teachings of Prophet Amos has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Teachings of Prophet Amos with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Teachings of Prophet Amos to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean ? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean .
   C. Say The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  has no place in daily life.
   D. Use The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Redemption after the Fall of Man? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Redemption after the Fall of Man.
   B. Use Redemption after the Fall of Man to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Redemption after the Fall of Man has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Redemption after the Fall of Man with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Background of Prophet Amos? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Background of Prophet Amos.
   B. Use Background of Prophet Amos to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Background of Prophet Amos with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Background of Prophet Amos has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of The Exodus? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Exodus with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say The Exodus has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Exodus.
   D. Use The Exodus to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Waste food daily

7. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Spreading rumours

8. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

9. Which response best shows understanding of Loyalty to God? (1 mark)
   A. Say Loyalty to God has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Loyalty to God.
   C. Use Loyalty to God to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Loyalty to God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of The Old Testament Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Old Testament Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Old Testament Prophets.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Old Testament Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say The Old Testament Prophets has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Stewardship Over Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stewardship Over Creation.
   B. Use Stewardship Over Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Stewardship Over Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Stewardship Over Creation has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of The Sinai Covenant? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Sinai Covenant to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Sinai Covenant.
   C. Say The Sinai Covenant has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Sinai Covenant with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain The Old Testament Prophets and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Background of Prophet Amos and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Teachings of Prophet Amos and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

3. D — Apply the teaching of Redemption after the Fall of Man with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. C — Apply the teaching of Background of Prophet Amos with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. A — Apply the teaching of The Exodus with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. D — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

9. D — Apply the teaching of Loyalty to God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. D — Apply the teaching of The Sinai Covenant with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The Old Testament Prophets; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
